digest.component_or_area: live-DC test harness and probe readiness gate
propositions: The harness readiness gate polls /rest/api/2/serverInfo until 200 but never verifies that GreenHopper custom fields (Epic Link, Epic Name) are registered

A system-only field inventory (27 system fields, zero customfield_* entries) can be observed 1 second after serverInfo answers 200, meaning the gate declares readiness before the required fields exist

The harness passes tests only by accident of slowness (dependencies, test collection delay post-readiness) rather than by sound readiness verification, making timing flakes misattributable to image degrades
The probe path was fixed to poll field inventory (1387) but the harness path was left on serverInfo polling, creating divergence between two tiers that should share one readiness definition
A system-only field inventory must be treated as NOT ready, never as a degraded image, yet no test pins this behavior, leaving the harness vulnerable to latent flakes
